cards.title: Moon Market Framed Setting
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only scene card for inventing one pretend framed view at the Moon Muffin Market: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold it like a small window frame, and ask the child to sketch one market detail before writing: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pretend you are looking through an imaginary window at the Moon Muffin Market; write the first place detail you see: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: Through the pretend frame, the Moon Muffin Market has a stall beside ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: Add one color, shape, or sign that makes this market setting clearer: ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A small muffin cart appears in the framed view beside ____________________, and the setting gives the story its first clue.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: From the window-seat story frame, I saw ____________________, then the market felt ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain place word with a clearer setting word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch one stall shape first, then label the setting detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: On another paper, add one new Moon Market view detail: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Helper View
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only scene card for inventing one pretend message helper in a framed view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a small frame on scrap paper, and invite one helper badge sketch before this blank: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine the window view shows one Puddle Planet helper; give the helper a job and a tiny choice: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The Puddle Planet helper sorts pretend messages by ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: The helper's careful habit is ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A pretend message drifts into the framed view near ____________________, and the helper decides what to do next.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: The puddle helper checked ____________________, then chose ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact character action a reader can picture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the helper badge, then write one character word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: On another paper, invent one more pretend message for ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Train Movement View
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only scene card for showing gentle movement inside an imagined window view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and draw three small frame boxes so the writer can sketch start, pause, and next motion: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine the Buttonwood Library Train moving through a story window; choose what shifts, stops, or rolls by: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The library train begins moving when the shelf marker points toward ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: The next motion in the framed view is ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The Buttonwood Library Train moves past ____________________, then pauses for one shelf clue.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: First the train moved toward ____________________. Next it paused beside ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one clear movement word so the scene changes on the page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number two tiny frame boxes, then fill only the first motion: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: On another paper, add one new train motion that begins with ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Sensory View
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only scene card for adding color, sound, or texture to a pretend weather-window view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card near a table view and ask for one pretend sensory clue before the writer fills this blank: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine Teacup Town's framed view shows one story clue; choose a color, sound, or texture: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The teacup weather window glows the color of ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: The tiny sound in the framed view is ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: When the pretend window glowed ____________________, Teacup Town changed one small plan.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: The teacup window clicked softly as ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one sensory word that makes the window scene clearer: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one tiny weather mark and label its feeling: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: On another paper, add a new color, sound, or texture to ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Notice View
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only scene card for writing one made-up notice inside a pretend framed park view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a small board shape, and ask the writer to choose one pretend notice clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine a tiny Pocket Park board inside a story window; write what the pretend notice asks a character to notice: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The Pocket Park notice says ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: The clue beside the notice is ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A park helper sees a made-up notice about ____________________, and the framed scene changes.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: Under the Pocket Park board, ____________________ waited for someone to notice.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague notice word with a clearer story word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Copy only one notice word neatly into the blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: On another paper, make one second pretend notice about ____________________.

cards.title: Spoon Ferry Object View
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only scene card for giving one story object a clear job in an imagined harbor view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a simple frame around the harbor prompt, and ask for one story-only object: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine an invented window view of Lunchbox Harbor; pick one object the spoon ferry carries: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: In the framed harbor view, the spoon ferry carries ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: This object helps the scene because ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The spoon ferry arrives with ____________________, and the harbor helper changes one small plan.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: At Lunchbox Harbor, the spoon ferry brought ____________________ to the edge of ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague object word with an exact noun or detail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the object first, then write its tiny job: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: On another paper, add a second ferry object called ____________________.
